title: Sample data
description:
The Assign action is STILL failing in the live runtime. I have retested it after your previous changes and the exact same error remains:

UndefinedTable: relation "twasta.SUPPORT360_TICKET" does not exist

The runtime SQL shown when I click Assign is:

UPDATE "twasta"."SUPPORT360_TICKET" SET "STATUS" = 'Assigned', "ASSIGNED_AGENT" = ... WHERE "TICKET_NO" = ...

This proves that the deployed runtime is still executing logic that references "twasta"."SUPPORT360_TICKET". Do not respond that the source file uses db.update('SUPPORT360_TICKET', ...). That does not solve the runtime error.

Please investigate the actual deployed Assign action and find exactly where this SQL is being generated. Check the action, business logic, generated SQL, dependent validation, model binding, and deployment/runtime cache.

Fix the actual runtime implementation using the correct Support360 ticket model/data binding. Do NOT use twasta.SUPPORT360_TICKET as a raw SQL table reference.

After fixing:

Deploy/redeploy the corrected logic.
Refresh/restart the runtime if required to remove stale logic.
Test assigning Ticket No. 10 to a valid agent.
Verify Status changes to Assigned.
Verify Assigned Agent is populated.
Verify an Activity Log entry is created.

Do not mark this task complete unless the Assign action actually works in the live runtime. If you cannot modify the deployed logic automatically, tell me exactly which action/object must be opened in the designer and what needs to be changed manually.

phases.title: Master & lookup data
phases.rationale: Category and priority masters must exist before tickets can reference them.

phases.title: Core transactions
phases.rationale: Ticket creation and the role-based ticket handling transactions build on the masters.

phases.title: Shared schema
phases.rationale: The Ticket fact dataset must be defined before any visual can query it.

phases.title: Visuals & charts
phases.rationale: All grids, cards and charts are built on the ticket schema.

phases.title: Dashboards
phases.rationale: Role dashboards embed the visuals completed in the previous phase.
